narrative: The website has a few accessibility issues related to colour contrast and link identification. The main content structure, page title, and headings are generally well-implemented. However, the 'Book online' button and the 'Privacy policy' link do not meet WCAG AA contrast or styling requirements. Additionally, text in the hero section requires manual verification due to an overlay on an image.

findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 3.75 (foreground color: #ffffff, background color: #d4622f, font size: 12.0pt (16px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1
findings.note: The 'Book online' button has a contrast ratio of 3.75:1, which is below the required 4.5:1 ratio for WCAG AA compliance. This makes the button difficult to read for users with low vision.
findings.suggested_fix: Increase the contrast between the button background colour (#d4622f) and text colour (#ffffff) by darkening the background or lightening the text.

findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  The link has insufficient color contrast of 1.47:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #ffffff, surrounding text: #cfd6d9)
  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text
findings.note: The 'Privacy policy' link has low contrast with the surrounding text and lacks any distinct styling (like an underline), making it hard for users, especially those with low vision or colour blindness, to identify it as a link.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply a style (such as an underline) to the link and ensure the link text has sufficient contrast against both the surrounding text and the background.

findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element's background color could not be determined because element contains an image node
findings.evidence: The element contains an image node, so background colour could not be determined.
findings.note: The text in the hero section (H1) overlays an image, so it cannot be automatically verified for contrast. This needs to be checked manually to ensure the text remains legible against the background image.
